mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 6% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply chain, which leads to lower corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO YoY < -2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which signals a restrictive monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is increasing, it signals a tight labor market with increasing wages, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased corporate costs.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage inflation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of UNRATE < 5% and increasing PAYEMS does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST growth does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is decreasing, it signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of GDPC1 YoY < 2% and decreasing INDPRO does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).
